item.title: Dixon Technologies shares: JM Financial cuts target price by 20%; stock up 3%
item.description: The brokerage has cut its earnings per share (EPS) estimates by 6-16 per cent across FY26-28E. Now values Dixon at 45x Dec’27E EPS, vs. 50x earlier, citing the uncertainties over growth.

item.title: Vedanta shares crash 8% post Q3 earnings but brokerages are bullish; here's why
item.description: Vedanta stock fell 8.31% to Rs 702.40 in the current session against the previous close of Rs 766.10.

item.title: This small-cap offshore oilfield services stock surged over 53% in six months; what lies ahead?
item.description: The stock is trading above 5-day, 10-day, 20-day, 30-day, 50-day, 100-day, 150-day and 200-day simple moving averages (SMAs).

item.title: Adani Group stock to buy: Why analysts see 40% upside in Adani Power post Q3 results
item.description: Brokerage firms continue to remain positive on Adani Power Ltd even after a mixed set of numbers in the December 2025 quarter.

item.title: Smartphone makers seek PLI push in budget as rising costs test Make-in-India ambitions
item.description: Domestic and international smartphone makers say the next phase of India’s electronics strategy must move beyond finished-device assembly toward a stronger local supply chain for components.

item.title: Apple sees strong India momentum, Tim Cook says, after iPhone 17 fuels record sales
item.description: The results highlight Apple’s push to broaden its user base beyond mature markets such as the US and Europe, with India increasingly central to both sales growth and manufacturing expansion.

item.title: Hic hic hurray! Cheaper imports are just the beginning; Inside the India–EU FTA’s big alcobev reset
item.description: The India-EU FTA significantly reduces tariffs across key categories including wine, spirits and beer, reshaping dynamics of premiumisation, quality standards and export opportunities for India’s burgeoning beverage sector.

item.title: Is India prepared for a likely geopolitical turbulence? CEA Nageswaran says this
item.description: CEA Anantha Nageswaran said many of the reforms were already in the works even before the geopolitical scene turned turbulent.
